purpose: Source-traceable accessible descriptions for every diagram in the bounded Unit 023 repair.
editorial_method: Each description was checked retrospectively against the frozen TikZ or tikzcd body and its immediately surrounding English prose. The description records every mathematical object and arrow, the commutativity or exactness asserted at that use, and the diagram's local purpose. This is an accessibility and source-association repair, not a new mathematical proof or a claim of prior canon consultation.
rendering_choice: Complete equivalent English descriptions are used at the exact figure locations. This avoids lossy rasterization, remains reflowable and screen-reader accessible, and preserves the source diagram IDs. Deterministic SVG remains a permissible later enhancement but is not required for semantic completeness.
model_provenance: Accessible-description correction produced by OpenAI Codex — GPT-5.6 Sol, Ultra effort.

entries.actual_use: Exactness criterion in Lemma prop:Abel-cat-exact-aux.
entries.description_en: Exactness-criterion commutative square. The top arrow is an epimorphism from S' to S; the left vertical arrow maps S' to X'; the right vertical arrow is h from S to X; and the bottom arrow is f from X' to X. The two composites from S' to X are equal.
entries.rationale: Names all four arrows and states the equality represented by the square.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited terse edge list omitted the square's purpose and composite equality.

entries.actual_use: Factorization step in the converse direction of the exactness criterion.
entries.description_en: Factorization square and triangle. The top epimorphism maps S' to S; the vertical arrows map S' to X' and h maps S to X; the bottom arrow is f from X' to X; and the dashed diagonal arrow is alpha from X' to S. The outer square commutes, h composed with alpha equals f, and alpha after S' to X' equals the epimorphism S' to S.
entries.rationale: Makes the dashed arrow's direction and both triangle equalities explicit.
entries.rejected_alternative: A generic category-diagram caption did not state what alpha proves.

entries.actual_use: Main Snake Lemma diagram eqn:snake.
entries.description_en: Snake Lemma diagram. The top row is Ker' to Ker to Ker''. The second exact row is X' to X by f, to X'' by g, then to 0. The third exact row is 0 to Y', to Y by u, then to Y'' by v. The bottom row is Coker' to Coker to Coker''. The three vertical columns are Ker' to X' to Y' to Coker', Ker to X to Y to Coker, and Ker'' to X'' to Y'' to Coker''; every column is exact and all ordinary squares commute. A dashed connecting morphism delta goes from Ker'' to Coker'.
entries.rationale: Enumerates every row, column, labeled map, exactness condition, and the dashed connecting morphism.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption stopped after eight arrows and hid twelve further arrows.

entries.actual_use: Four-row pullback-pushout construction of the connecting morphism eqn:snake-conn.
entries.description_en: Four-row exact diagram used to construct delta. Write P for the fiber product X times over X'' with Ker'', and Q for the pushout Coker' coproduct over Y' with Y. The rows are: 0 to Ker(g), included by s into P, then P epimorphically to Ker''; 0 to Ker(g), included into X, then g from X to X'', then to 0; 0 to Y', then u to Y, then epimorphically to Coker(u), then to 0; and Coker' included into Q, then the epimorphism t from Q to Coker(u), then to 0. Vertical maps are the identity on Ker(g), P to X, Ker'' to X'', the dashed map Ker(g) to Y', X to Y, the dashed map X'' to Coker(u), Y' to Coker', Y to Q, and the identity on Coker(u). All displayed regions commute. The square P-Ker''-X-X'' is a pullback, and the square Y'-Y-Coker'-Q is a pushout.
entries.rationale: Expands the full construction, including every row and vertical comparison plus the marked universal-property squares.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited description replaced fourteen arrows with a count and did not identify the pushout.

entries.actual_use: Naturality comparison for two Snake Lemma data diagrams.
entries.description_en: Naturality comparison between two short-exact-sequence diagrams. The upper pair of exact rows is X' to X to X'' to 0 and 0 to Y' to Y to Y''. The lower pair is the corresponding underlined sequence: underlined X' to underlined X to underlined X'' to 0 and 0 to underlined Y' to underlined Y to underlined Y''. Each X term maps vertically to its underlined counterpart, each Y term maps vertically to its underlined counterpart, and within each pair the X', X, and X'' terms map respectively to the corresponding Y', Y, and Y'' terms. Every resulting face commutes.
entries.rationale: States all four exact rows and all six natural comparison maps without hiding crossing arrows.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption hid sixteen arrows and did not explain the two compared diagrams.

entries.actual_use: Naturality square for the connecting morphism.
entries.description_en: Naturality square for connecting morphisms. The top arrow is delta from Ker'' to Coker'. Natural vertical morphisms map Ker'' to underlined Ker'' and Coker' to underlined Coker'. The bottom arrow is underlined delta from underlined Ker'' to underlined Coker'. The square commutes.
entries.rationale: Distinguishes the two deltas and both natural vertical maps.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited text collapsed underlined and un-underlined objects into the same names.

entries.actual_use: Target lifting diagram for exactness of Ker' to Ker to Ker''.
entries.description_en: Snake Lemma proof lift. The top epimorphism h maps S' to S; S' maps down to Ker'; psi maps S down to Ker; and the diagonal map from S to Ker'' is zero. The middle row is Ker' to Ker to Ker'', with inclusions down to X', X, and X''. The bottom row is X' to X by f and X to X'' by g. Every square and triangle commutes.
entries.rationale: Includes the zero triangle, all kernel inclusions, and the exactness-lift purpose.
entries.rejected_alternative: No omission is acceptable because this is the proof's target construction.

entries.actual_use: First application of the exactness criterion in the Snake Lemma proof.
entries.description_en: Auxiliary lifting diagram. The top epimorphism h maps S' to S; S' maps down to X'; S maps down to X and diagonally by the zero morphism to X''. The bottom row is X' to X by f and X to X'' by g. The square and zero triangle commute.
entries.rationale: Corrects an inherited caption copied from the preceding kernel diagram.
entries.rejected_alternative: The old description incorrectly mentioned Ker', Ker, and Ker'', which do not occur here.

entries.actual_use: Desired lifting square for exactness of Ker to Ker'' to Coker'.
entries.description_en: Desired commutative lifting square. The top arrow is an epimorphism from S_0 to S; the left vertical arrow maps S_0 to Ker; the right vertical arrow is psi from S to Ker''; and the bottom arrow maps Ker to Ker''. The two composites from S_0 to Ker'' are equal.
entries.rationale: Restores the actual S_0-Ker square, which had inherited the preceding S'-X diagram's caption.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited objects did not match this source segment.

entries.actual_use: Lift of psi through the fiber product P.
entries.description_en: Lift through the fiber product P = X times over X'' with Ker''. The top epimorphism maps S_1 to S; S_1 maps down to P; psi maps S down to Ker'' and the diagonal map from S to 0 is zero. The bottom row is P to Ker'' to 0. The square and zero triangle commute.
entries.rationale: Names the fiber-product object and all six arrows at this proof step.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited description was shifted from the following S_0 diagram.

entries.actual_use: Comparison of delta psi with delta_0 in the Snake Lemma proof.
entries.description_en: Commutative comparison for delta psi. The top row is S to Ker'' by psi and then to Coker' by delta; Coker' includes downward into Q = Coker' coproduct over Y' with Y. Below, S_1 maps epimorphically up to S and right to P = X times over X'' with Ker''. The object P maps up to Ker'', right to Q by delta_0, and down to X. The bottom arrow maps X to Y, and Y maps up to Q. All displayed regions commute, so the zero top composite controls the middle composite.
entries.rationale: Enumerates the top, middle, bottom, and vertical arrows and explains why the comparison appears.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption described the preceding P-to-Ker'' lift instead.

entries.actual_use: Application of the exactness criterion to X' to Y' to Coker'.
entries.description_en: Exactness-criterion lift for X' to Y' to Coker'. The top epimorphism maps S_0 to S_1; k maps S_0 down to X'; xi maps S_1 down to Y'; and the diagonal map from S_1 to Coker' is zero. The bottom row is X' to Y' to Coker'. The square and zero triangle commute.
entries.rationale: Corrects the one-step caption shift and states the zero map used by the argument.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited description belonged to the preceding delta_0 comparison.

entries.actual_use: Compatibility diagram defining lambda and comparing a, b, f, and u.
entries.description_en: Compatibility diagram defining lambda. Across the top, S_0 maps epimorphically to S_1 and S_1 maps to P = X times over X'' with Ker''. The vertical arrows are k from S_0 to X', xi from S_1 to Y', and P to a displayed copy of X. A diagonal arrow lambda maps S_0 to that copy of X. The remaining arrows are a from X' to Y', f from X' to a second displayed copy of X, u from Y' to Y, and b from each displayed copy of X to Y. Both squares, the lambda triangle, and the right-hand trapezoid commute.
entries.rationale: Distinguishes the two displayed copies of X and accounts for every arrow and region cited in the prose.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption belonged to the preceding S_0-S_1-Coker' lift.

entries.actual_use: Factorization of lambda minus f k through Ker.
entries.description_en: Factorization diagram for lambda minus f composed with k. The top row consists of epimorphisms S_0 to S_1 to S. Vertically, S_0 maps to Ker, Ker includes into X, psi maps S to Ker'', and Ker'' includes into X''. There is an arrow Ker to Ker'' and a bottom arrow g from X to X''. A curved arrow labeled lambda minus f k maps S_0 directly to X. The lower square and curved triangle commute, and the proof reduces the remaining upper square to the outer frame.
entries.rationale: Records the curved correction map and separates known from still-to-be-proved commutativity.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption described the following lambda-P diagram.

entries.actual_use: Known outer-frame diagram concluding the Snake Lemma proof.
entries.description_en: Known comparison diagram for the outer frame. The top row consists of epimorphisms S_0 to S_1 to S. A curved arrow lambda maps S_0 to X. The object S_1 maps down to P = X times over X'' with Ker''; psi maps S down to Ker''. The object P maps right to Ker'' and down to X; Ker'' maps down to X''; and g maps X to X''. Every displayed region commutes.
entries.rationale: Supplies all nine arrows and identifies this as the known comparison used in the preceding reduction.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption was shifted and omitted one arrow.

entries.actual_use: Five Lemma statement prop:5-lemma.
entries.description_en: Five Lemma diagram with two exact rows. The upper row is X_1 to X_2 to X_3 to X_4 to X_5, and the lower row is Y_1 to Y_2 to Y_3 to Y_4 to Y_5. The five vertical arrows are f_1 from X_1 to Y_1, f_2 from X_2 to Y_2, f_3 from X_3 to Y_3, f_4 from X_4 to Y_4, and f_5 from X_5 to Y_5. All four squares commute.
entries.rationale: Places the complete five-column diagram at the proposition statement and closes the reported d015 mismatch.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited d015 caption incorrectly described the preceding Snake Lemma proof.

entries.actual_use: First lifting square in the proof of the Five Lemma.
entries.description_en: First lifting square in the Five Lemma proof. The top arrow is an epimorphism from S' to S; the left vertical arrow maps S' to X_2; the right vertical arrow is h from S to X_3; and the bottom arrow maps X_2 to X_3. The two composites from S' to X_3 are equal.
entries.rationale: Places the four-object lift at its actual proof use and closes the reported d016 mismatch.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited d016 caption incorrectly repeated the five-column statement diagram.

entries.actual_use: Two-stage epimorphic construction used in the Five Lemma proof.
entries.description_en: Two-stage lifting construction. Across the top are epimorphisms S''' to S'' and S'' to S'. The vertical maps send S''' to X_1, S'' to Y_1, and S' to X_2. Along the bottom, f_1 maps X_1 to Y_1, Y_1 maps to Y_2, and f_2 maps X_2 down to Y_2. The two construction regions commute.
entries.rationale: Preserves the two successive lifts and the f_1/f_2 comparison used immediately afterward.
entries.rejected_alternative: A bare object-and-arrow list did not state the two-stage construction.

entries.actual_use: Composite diagram whose upper-left square is proved commutative in the Five Lemma argument.
entries.description_en: Composite diagram in the Five Lemma proof. The top row consists of epimorphisms S''' to S' and S' to S. Vertically, S''' maps to X_1, S' maps to X_2, and h maps S to X_3. The middle row is X_1 to X_2 to X_3 to X_4. The lower arrows are f_1 from X_1 to Y_1, f_2 from X_2 to Y_2, and Y_1 to Y_2. At this point every displayed region except the upper-left square S'''-S'-X_1-X_2 is already known to commute; the following argument proves that square too.
entries.rationale: Accounts for every arrow and accurately marks the one region not yet established at the diagram's use.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption described only the earlier four-object lift.

entries.actual_use: First route around the unresolved upper-left square.
entries.description_en: Right-then-down route around the upper-left square of the preceding diagram: start at S''', follow the top epimorphism to S', then follow the vertical arrow from S' to X_2. The resulting composite is S''' to S' to X_2.
entries.rationale: Interprets the otherwise unlabeled path icon at its actual use.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption described an unrelated seven-object commutative diagram.

entries.actual_use: Second route around the unresolved upper-left square.
entries.description_en: Down-then-right route around the upper-left square of the preceding diagram: start at S''', follow the vertical arrow to X_1, then follow the horizontal arrow from X_1 to X_2. The resulting composite is S''' to X_1 to X_2.
entries.rationale: Interprets the second unlabeled path icon and distinguishes it from the first route.
entries.rejected_alternative: The inherited caption described the preceding large composite diagram.

entries.actual_use: First known commutative square used after composing both routes with f_2.
entries.description_en: Known commutative square from the Five Lemma diagram. The top arrow maps X_1 to X_2; the left vertical arrow is f_1 from X_1 to Y_1; the right vertical arrow is f_2 from X_2 to Y_2; and the bottom arrow maps Y_1 to Y_2. Thus f_2 after X_1 to X_2 equals Y_1 to Y_2 after f_1.
entries.rationale: Names the four objects, four maps, and exact composite equality used by the cancellation argument.
entries.rejected_alternative: A generic path-composition caption did not expose this square's maps.

entries.actual_use: Second known commutative square used after composing both routes with f_2.
entries.description_en: Known commutative square for the two-stage lift. The top arrow maps S''' to S'; the left vertical arrow maps S''' to Y_1; the right vertical arrow maps S' to Y_2; and the bottom arrow maps Y_1 to Y_2. The two composites from S''' to Y_2 are equal.
entries.rationale: Names every map and states the equality needed to compare the two routes after composition with f_2.
entries.rejected_alternative: A generic path-composition caption did not expose this square's objects or equality.

expert_review_status: Open to later correction; no human-review hold applies.
